domain(person,[devin,brooks,oaklyn,stephanie]).

% If Devin enjoys travelling, then he is either an explorer or has patience, but not both.
axiom(s1, rule([enjoys_travelling(devin)], xor(explorer(devin),patience(devin)))).

% If Devin either reads ancient texts or unearths fossils (but not both), then he collects relics.
axiom(s2, rule([xor(reads_ancient_texts(devin),unearths_fossils(devin))], collects_relics(devin))).

% If Devin likes history, then he is either an archaeologist or enjoys museums, but not both.
axiom(s3, rule([likes_history(devin)], xor(archaeologist(devin),enjoys_museums(devin)))).

% Devin has curiosity.
axiom(s4, curiosity(devin)).

% If Brooks studies ancient cultures, then he is either an expert in Inca history or makes groundbreaking discoveries (or both).
axiom(s5, rule([studies_ancient_cultures(brooks)], or(expert_inca_history(brooks),makes_groundbreaking_discoveries(brooks)))).

% Devin seeks security.
axiom(s6, seeks_security(devin)).

% If Devin has curiosity or loves challenges, then he is an explorer.
axiom(s7, rule([or(curiosity(devin),loves_challenges(devin))], explorer(devin))).

% Oaklyn does not unearth fossils.
axiom(s8, not(unearths_fossils(oaklyn))).

% Devin does not unearth fossils.
axiom(s9, not(unearths_fossils(devin))).

% If Stephanie has curiosity or loves challenges, then he is an explorer.
axiom(s10, rule([or(curiosity(stephanie),loves_challenges(stephanie))], explorer(stephanie))).

% Stephanie makes groundbreaking discoveries.
axiom(s11, makes_groundbreaking_discoveries(stephanie)).

% Brooks seeks security.
axiom(s12, seeks_security(brooks)).

% Stephanie does not study ancient cultures.
axiom(s13, not(studies_ancient_cultures(stephanie))).

% Stephanie has curiosity.
axiom(s14, curiosity(stephanie)).

% Devin loves challenges.
axiom(s15, loves_challenges(devin)).

% Devin reads ancient texts.
axiom(s16, reads_ancient_texts(devin)).

% Oaklyn reads ancient texts.
axiom(s17, reads_ancient_texts(oaklyn)).

% Devin either knows many languages or is an expert in Inca history.
axiom(s18, or(knows_many_languages(devin),expert_inca_history(devin))).

% Anyone who embraces challenges or has a passion for history is adventurous.
axiom(s19, rule([or(embraces_challenges(X),passion_for_history(X))], adventurous(X))).
